rows.claim: Resuming a failed run deterministically re-rejects the journaled failed asks; the only way to actually re-execute a failed ask is to amend into a NEW run, never resume.
rows.quote: Resuming a failed run replays the failure, not a retry: failed asks are journaled and re-rejected deterministically (scheduler.ts:371-381). To actually re-run a failed ask you must amend into a new run, not resume.
rows.steal: If tonight's probe run errors, fix the script and AmendWorkflow into a new run instead of ResumeWorkflowRun; log the old and new run ids side by side in the lane receipt so the replay-vs-retry behavior is on the record.
rows.falsifier: Resume a run whose ask failed and watch that ask execute fresh instead of re-rejecting (law dead); or scheduler.ts:371-381 showing failed rows are dropped from replay.
